title: 3 oz stainless mini pitchers
text: 3 oz stainless mini pitchers. These are about medium weight, and about what I expected.  However, I do wish the handles were not so sharp edged.  Other than that, they are tiny.  Only 3 oz.  I am using with individual salad dressings. But could be great for individual creams too.  Washed top rack dishwasher.  So far, so good.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.
